grid.layout_notes: Official 3-3-3-3-3-3. xWays on middle 4; size expands with connected Ways (up to 12).

win_system.notes: Ways expanded heavily by xWays sizes 2–12; exact base ways not printed.

respins.how_it_works: Loot Respin: Loot + any special → expand/lock reel 1; specials sticky; unlock + final respin when no new special; Loot again can retrigger.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: xWays expand by connected count; Loot locks reel 1 during respin.

other.name: xSplit Wild / xSplit Nudge
other.how_it_works: xSplit Wild (not reel 1) splits left on row (mult if multi-split); does not split Loot; doubles xWays mult when splitting Ways. xSplit Nudge stacks, nudges stopping before specials, then splits each position left.

other.name: Radiation Levels
other.how_it_works: In Raid/Plunder: every 3 collected xSplit/xWays/xSplit Nudge → next Radiation level (remove low pays); +1 spin per level; Level 4 → Binge Spins.

wilds.name: xSplit Wild
wilds.behavior: Any reel except 1; splits left on row; doubles xWays mult if splitting Ways.

wilds.name: xSplit Nudge
wilds.behavior: Except reel 1; stacked nudge then split each row left.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: Any reel except 1. Not split — becomes Super Scatter instead. 3/4/5 → 7/10/13 Raid; if ≥1 Super Scatter → Plunder instead.

scatters.name: Super Scatter
scatters.behavior: From split attempt on Scatter; in Plunder its position + below become sticky xSplit; in Raid converts self + regulars below to xSplit.

multipliers.name: xWays size / split mult
multipliers.behavior: xWays size 2–12; split shows multiplier when split more than once.

specials.name: xWays
specials.behavior: Middle 4; reveal random regular (synced if multiple); size 2–4 / 3–8 / 4–12 by 1/2/3 connected on reel.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways on 3×6 with xWays (2–12), xSplit Wild, xSplit Nudge. Loot+special → Loot Respin. 3/4/5 Scatter → 7/10/13 Raid (sticky specials; Radiation levels); ≥1 Super Scatter → Plunder; Radiation L4 → Binge. Boosters 3×/10×/30×. Cap 25,920× (Wafer Thin Mint).

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional xBet 3× (4× FS chance), 1 Guaranteed xSplit Nudge 10×, or Loot Respins 30×.

phases.name: Spin + splits / Loot
phases.what_happens: xWays reveal/expand; xSplit/Nudge split left; optional Loot Respin chain.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3/4/5 Scatter → Raid or Plunder (if Super Scatter).

base_game_loop.notes: CMS; source dir x-ways-hoarder-2; slug matches sibling nolimit-xways-hoarder.

modes.name: Raid Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: xSplit / xWays / xSplit Nudge sticky after landing. Super Scatter converts self + regulars below to xSplit.
modes.progressive_state: Radiation levels at 3/6/9/12 collected specials; remove low pays; L4 → Binge.
modes.end_condition: Spins done / Binge / Wafer Thin Mint 25,920×.

phases.name: Radiation / Binge
phases.what_happens: Every 3 specials → level up +1 spin; L4 enters Binge.

modes.name: Plunder Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Super Scatter position + below sticky as xSplit; Radiation as Raid.

phases.name: Enter Plunder
phases.what_happens: 7/10/13; sticky xSplit column from Super Scatter.

modes.effects: Raid-like with sticky Super Scatter xSplit column.

modes.name: Binge Spins
modes.trigger: Raid or Plunder reaches Radiation Level 4.
modes.spins_awarded: Continues remaining spins at Binge symbol set.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Only top 2 highest characters + highest object can land.

phases.name: Binge
phases.what_happens: Reduced symbol set for remaining spins.

modes.effects: Final Radiation tier; lean symbol set.

features.name: xWays
features.effects: Reveal synced regular; expand 2–12 by connected count.

features.name: xSplit Wild / Nudge
features.effects: Split left; double Ways mult; Nudge then split.

features.name: Loot Respin
features.effects: Lock reel 1; sticky specials; unlock + final respin.

ante_bet.effects: xBet 3×: 4× more likely to trigger Free Spins.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Raid 7/10/13; Plunder; Binge L4; Loot Respin; boosters 3/10/30×; max 25920×.
